rules.name: Eye of the Gorgon
rules.description:
The bearer’s unit gains Horror. 
 During Combat Choices, select one Rank-and-File model part, or a model part on the bearer’s model, in the Front Rank of the bearer’s unit: that model part gains Petrifying Stare.

rules.name: Caedhren's Pennon
rules.description: While the bearer’s unit is part of a Combined Charge, that unit, as well as all other units that are Charging the same target, must reroll failed Charge Range rolls, and gain Devastating Charge (Hard Target (1)).

rules.name: Banner of Urlain
rules.description:
Exclusive (Captain, Silent Assassin). The unit’s maximum size is changed to 15 models for units entirely with Height 1, and to 6 models for units entirely with Height 2. 
 Rank-and-File model parts with Elf in the bearer’s unit gain Devastating Charge (+1 Att).

rules.name: Mastery of Slaughter
rules.description:
+1 Str, +1 AP. 
 If the wielder causes one or more HP losses with this weapon, then all attacks made by Rank-and-File models in its unit gain +1 to hit, with Duration: Round of Combat.

rules.name: Transcendence
rules.description: For each HP loss the wielder inflicts with this weapon on enemy models, it gains +1 Str and +1 AP, up to a maximum of +2 each, with Duration: Permanent.

rules.name: Seal of the Republic
rules.description: For each HP loss the wearer inflicts with Standard Melee Attacks on enemy models, it gains +1 Armour, with Duration: Permanent.

rules.name: Ceinran's Scales
rules.description: The bearer can cast Whispers of the Veil (Evocation) as a Bound Spell (4+).

rules.name: Ring of the Obsidian Thrones
rules.description: Unless the wearer is Shaken, Break Tests and Panic Tests taken by friendly units within 6" of the wearer gain Minimised.

rules.name: Moithir's Mirror
rules.description:
The bearer gains Aegis (5+, against Melee Attacks). If one or more Melee Attacks are allocated against the bearer, it gains Grind Attack (3, Str 4, AP 2, Magical Attacks, Unmodifiable), with Duration: Round of Combat. 
 This Grind Attack is always resolved with Agi 0.
 (Note that attacks made at Agility Step 0 can trigger this effect.)

rules.name: Beastmaster's Vial
rules.description:
One use only. Duration: End of Combat 
 May be activated at the start of any Round of Combat. One friendly unit entirely with Beast within 12" of the bearer gains Dying Blow.

sharedRules.name: Academy Commander
sharedRules.description:
The model part gains Academy. 
 Model parts with Academy in the model’s unit gain Artistry of Death.

sharedRules.name: Beastmaster
sharedRules.description:
The model part gains Slaver. 
 Apply the following effects to units within range of this model’s Commanding Presence (friend or foe): 
 • Friendly units containing Beast: Courage Tests gain Minimised. 
 • Friendly units: rolls for the number of hits from Stomp Attack gain Maximised. 
 • Enemy units: rolls for the number of hits from Stomp Attack gain Minimised.

sharedRules.name: Extraordinary Specimen
sharedRules.description: The Manticore gains Stomp Attack (D3), and its base size is changed to 50×100 mm.

sharedRules.name: Meeting of Minds
sharedRules.description: The model gains Scent of Blood, and treats all friendly models with Beast as Insignificant.

sharedRules.name: Dancers of Yema
sharedRules.description:
The model gains Aegis (5+, against Melee Attacks), First Strike (+1 Att),Elven Finesse, Weapon Master. 
 It also gains Shield, Great Weapon, Halberd.

sharedRules.name: Temple Acolytes
sharedRules.description: The “Dread Acolyte” model part gains Artistry of Death, Paired Weapons and Temple.

sharedRules.name: Warlock Acolytes
sharedRules.description:
The unit gains Wizard Conclave (2), Irresistible Will. 
 The “Dread Acolyte” model part gains Warlock. 
 The unit selects its spells from:

sharedRules.name: Altar of Nabh
sharedRules.description:
The model gains Attached, Exclusive (Height 1), Frenzy, Fury, War Platform, Unruly.
 Model parts with Elf in friendly units within 12" of the Altar of Nabh gain Fury.

sharedRules.name: Altar of Tila
sharedRules.description:
The model’s Charge Speed and Mobility are always 0". 
 In addition, it gains Channel (2), Emplacement, Solitary, Fearless, Stubborn, Unstable. 
 When another friendly unit within 18" of the model suffers one or more HP losses from an enemy attack, the Altar of Tila may cause three hits with Str 4, AP 2, and Unmodifiable onto the enemy unit that caused those losses. This effect can only be used once per phase.

sharedRules.name: Altar of Yema
sharedRules.description:
The model gains Attached, War Platform, Exclusive (Height 1), and a single Attendant model part gains Petrifying Stare. 
 Whenever a friendly unit within 12" of the Altar of Yema initiates any kind of move (see the Definition and Terminology chapter in the Reference Handbook), the unit gains +1 Mobility and Devastating Charge (Strider), with Duration: End of Turn.

sharedRules.name: Harpoon Launcher
sharedRules.description:
AimRangeShotsStrAP318363
Attack Attributes: Accurate, Quick to Fire, Harpoon Launcher
Any unit that suffers one or more hits from this weapon loses Swiftstride, and cannot regain it in any way, until the start of the Active Player’s next Turn.

sharedRules.name: Colossal Kraken
sharedRules.description: The model’s base size is changed to 100×150 mm, the number of its HP is set to 8, and it gains 2 additional Lashmasters.

sharedRules.name: Coastal Predator
sharedRules.description: The model gains Hard Target (1) while in contact with a Water Terrain.

sharedRules.name: Under the Cover of Mists
sharedRules.description:
Enemy units within 8" of one or more Mist Leviathans suffer -1 to hit with Shooting Attacks. 
 In addition, during the first Game Turn, all models in friendly units containing Height 1 within 8" of one or more Mist Leviathans gain Hard Target (1).

sharedRules.name: Daeb Warfare
sharedRules.description:
When a unit containing Daeb Warfare is part of a Combined Charge, its Charge Range rolls gain Maximised. 
 When multiple units containing Daeb Warfare are Engaged in the same Combined Combat, each of these units gains First Strike (Resolute).

sharedRules.name: Irresistible Will
sharedRules.description: When casting a Learned Spell, any Dispelling Roll made against its Casting Roll suffers a -1 modifier.

sharedRules.name: Scent of Blood
sharedRules.description: Charge Range rolls made by units entirely with Scent of Blood gain Maximised if the target of the Charge contains a Health Pool that has fewer Health Points than its starting value.

sharedRules.name: Kraken’s Hide
sharedRules.description: The wearer gains +1 Armour and Strider (Water Terrain).

sharedRules.name: Artistry of Death
sharedRules.description: Standard Melee Attacks gain +1 to wound.

sharedRules.name: Petrifying Stare
sharedRules.description: At the model part’s Agility Step, each enemy unit in contact with it suffers two hits that are set to-wound on 5+, always have AP 10, Magical Attacks, Unmodifiable.

sharedRules.description:
Attacks made by the target suffer -1 AP.
 Attacks made against the target gain +1 AP.
 Attacks from spells are not affected.

sharedRules.name: Height of Hubris
